block.$description: dimension used by the tab panel component for padding block.

inline.$description: dimension used by the tab panel component for padding inline.

bg.$description: color used by the tab panel component for background (Tab_nav masters have no panel chrome: content sits on the ambient surface; the panel never paints a surface it does not own).

fg.$description: color used by the tab panel component for foreground (pairs a scheme-correct text color with whatever ground the transparent panel sits on — fixes black-on-black slotted text in dark).

color.$description: color used by the tab panel component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the tab panel component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the tab panel component for focus ring offset.
